name: SodiumGD
description: Ultra-aggressive rendering, particle, shader, and culling optimizer for Geometry Dash — inspired by Sodium for Minecraft.

preset.name: Optimization Preset
preset.description: Quick performance profile. Choose 'Custom' to configure every option individually.

no-glow.name: Disable Object Glow
no-glow.description: Strips additive glow sprites from all level objects. Massive GPU fill-rate & FPS boost.

bypass-shaders.name: Bypass Level Shaders
bypass-shaders.description: Skips 2.2 ShaderLayer FBO render-to-texture passes and per-frame shader math.

fast-culling.name: Aggressive Node Culling
fast-culling.description: Immediately skips rendering invisible, zero-scale, or zero-opacity nodes before OpenGL matrix transforms.

no-object-effects.name: Disable Object Enter/Exit Effects
no-object-effects.description: Forces m_hasNoEffects on all objects to avoid per-frame enter/exit animation math.

hide-bg-ground.name: Hide Background & Ground
hide-bg-ground.description: Hides background, middleground, and ground layers during gameplay to eliminate full-screen overdraw.

ultra-ldm.name: Ultra Low Detail Mode (Strip High Detail)
ultra-ldm.description: Completely skips loading high-detail decorative objects into PlayLayer, cutting RAM usage and CPU iteration time.

strip-decorations.name: Strip All Decorations (Potato / Layout Mode)
strip-decorations.description: Skips all non-interactive decoration objects while keeping solids, hazards, portals, pads, orbs, and triggers intact.

particle-mode.name: Particle Optimization
particle-mode.description: Controls CPU simulation & GPU drawing of particles in PlayLayer. 'Reduced' caps emission/updates; 'Disabled' removes them completely.

particle-cap.name: Max Particles Per System (Reduced Mode)
particle-cap.description: Maximum active particles allowed per CCParticleSystem when Particle Optimization is set to Reduced.

no-player-particles.name: Disable Player Glitter & Death Explosion
no-player-particles.description: Disables player drag/glitter particles and death explosion bursts.

no-player-glow.name: Disable Player Glow & Trail
no-player-glow.description: Hides player glow outline and regular streak trail to reduce overdraw.

auto-purge-textures.name: Auto-Purge Unused Textures
auto-purge-textures.description: Frees unused cached OpenGL textures when exiting a level to prevent RAM bloat and stutters.

high-process-priority.name: High Process Priority (Windows)
high-process-priority.description: Sets Geometry Dash process priority to High on Windows to reduce frame-time spikes.

show-fps-hud.name: Show FPS & Frame-Time HUD
show-fps-hud.description: Displays an ultra-lightweight FPS and frame-time (ms) counter in the top-left corner during gameplay.
